input: Draft a LinkedIn post about a framework feature and format it for the feed.

assertions.value: A blank line spends the line budget without spending characters
A brief opening sentence is a hook doing its job
Put a limit where it applies
Keep the review out of the copy
keep external links out of the body by default
Brand every asset with the Cratis mark
on every frame, because the feed can show any frame
Leave the logo out of alt text
Plan for the author to answer comments
is rewritten for it, not cross-posted
